title: Wikipedia: scrolling and page changes
description: Reads a long public article: the spotlight waits at the edge for off-screen targets, then follows a link to a new page.

steps.say: This is the Wikipedia article on teleprompters.
A spotlight can sit on any element: a heading, a picture, a button.
When the next target is further down, the light waits at the edge of the window until you scroll to it.
Click through to another page and the prompter follows.
New page, same prompter. It picked up where we left off.
That's the tour. Press the hotkey to finish.
